items.title: Travere Therapeutics Receives Notice of Allowance from the U.S. Patent and Trademark Office for U.S. Patent Application Directed to Certain Methods of Using FILSPARI® (sparsentan) in IgA Nephropathy
items.summary: Travere Therapeutics, Inc. (Nasdaq: TVTX) today announced that the United States Patent and Trademark Office (USPTO) issued a Notice of Allowance for U.S. Patent Application No. 19/253,088, titled “Biphenyl Sulfonamide Compounds for the Treatment of Kidney Diseases or Disorders,” directed to certain methods of using FILSPARI ® (sparsentan) in IgA nephropathy. Upon issuance, the patent is expected to provide U.S. patent coverage for certain methods of using sparsentan in IgA nephropathy into October 2037. The allowed application is expected to issue as a U.S. patent following payment of the issue fee and standard USPTO post-allowance processing. Travere expects to submit the issued patent for listing in the FDA’s Approved Drug Products with Therapeutic Equivalence Evaluations (commonly known as the “Orange Book”) promptly following grant. How to Personalize Your Backpack Your Way
items.summary: You already know what you like. You don't need anyone telling you what works. But there's something especially satisfying about taking a bag you love using every day and giving it just enough of your personality to feel different. Maybe that looks like a clean monogrammed backpack that feels polished and personal at the same time. Maybe it's a few well-placed backpack decorations that add texture, movement, or a little humor. Maybe it changes week to week, depending on your mood. If you've ever wondered how to decorate a backpack without ruining the structure, overwhelming the design, or committing to something you'll regret later, you're in the right place! Your Favorite Backpack That Holds It All If your day includes a laptop, a water bottle, a charger, notebooks, and at least three "just in case" items, the Bancroft Backpack is your bag. It's built for real life: • A padded laptop compartment (fits up to 15”) that actually protects your tech. • Two main zip compartments, so everything isn't fighting for space. • A front pocket with built-in organization (four slip pockets and a pen slot) so you're not digging for basics. • Two exterior slip pockets, including one that flexes to fit different water bottles. • A trolley sleeve that makes travel days easier, not harder. Make it yours: Start with a monogram if you want something permanent and polished. Then layer in function and personality: • Clip on the Zip Earbud Bag Charm, so your earbuds are always within reach (and not buried at the bottom of the bag). • Add a cute Backpack Bag Charm for a playful finishing touch. A Smaller Style for Lighter Days The Small Banbury Backpack may not pack a punch in terms of size, but it still shows up prepared. What makes it work: • Two zip compartments to keep your essentials separated (and easy to find). • A back slip pocket for quick-grab items like your phone. • Side pockets that quietly add extra function without bulk. • Interior pockets that keep everything from turning into one big pile. It's compact, but not limiting. Clean, but not boring. Make it yours: This is where monogrammed backpacks really shine. The smaller silhouette makes a monogram feel intentional, not overwhelming. Then keep personalization simple: • Add the Beaded Shell Bag Charm for texture and movement. • Or go with the Bitty Bear Bag Charm if you want something softer and a little unexpected. Throw it Over Your Shoulder With Style Our Lorman Sling Backpack is built for movement. Whether you're commuting, traveling, or just out for the day, it keeps everything close without slowing you down. What makes it different: • A streamlined, body-hugging shape that stays comfortable all day. • An adjustable strap (up to 44”), so you can wear it your way. • Two zip compartments + an exterior slip pocket for quick, easy access. • An interior zip pocket for smaller valuables. It's efficient. It's lightweight. It doesn't ask for attention, but it gets it. Make it yours: With a silhouette this clean, personalization should feel deliberate. • Clip on the Bitty Bear Bag Charm in a different pattern for contrast. Something soft against a sleek shape. • Or keep it practical with the Zip Earbud Bag Charm, so your essentials stay right where you need them. This is the minimalist approach to personalized bags: one or two small details, placed well. Little Details, Big Personality Decorative accessories can be practical, playful, or a little bit of both. The right bag charm adds personality to your backpack while giving you an easy way to switch things up whenever the mood strikes. Zip Earbud Bag Charm This is one of those stylish functional charms that quietly improves your routine. What it does well: • Holds most standard earbud cases, including wireless styles. • Keeps them protected with a secure zip closure. • Attaches easily with a hinge ring, so you can clip it exactly where it makes sense for you. Specs at a glance: • 3.25" wide x 2.75" high x 2" deep How to use it when you're thinking about how to decorate a backpack: Clip it near the top or side of your bag where you naturally reach. It's so easy it will quickly become part of your routine. Personalization tip: Pair a Leather Zip Earbud Bag Charm with a quilted cotton backpack to mix and match materials. Bancroft Backpack Bag Charm This bag charm adds something playful when your bag feels a little too plain. What makes it different: • A mini backpack design that mirrors the real thing. • A working zip pocket that's small, but usable. • A sturdy shape that doesn't collapse or lose structure over time. • Hinge ring attachment for easy repositioning. Specs at a glance: 3.5" wide x 2.5" high x 1.5" deep How to style it: Attach it to a front-facing zipper or side ring, so it's visible, but not competing. It adds dimension, especially on more structured bags like the Bancroft. It's subtle, but it changes the whole feel. Personalization tip: The Original Tote Bag Charm is another great way to show off your favorite Vera Bradley style and patterns in a fun super-mini way. Bitty Bear Bag Charm There's a reason this one works; it softens everything around it. What makes it stand out: • A lightweight, soft construction that moves naturally with your bag. • A 6" cord loop that makes it easy to attach to zippers, straps, or rings. • Enough detail to feel intentional, not novelty. Specs at a glance: 4" wide x 3.75" high How to use it: Pair it with a more structured bag to create contrast. If your backpack leans polished or minimal, this adds just enough personality without undoing the look. It's one of the easiest ways personalize your backpack without committing to anything permanent. Beaded Shell Bag Charm This charm brings soft texture and a coastal-inspired feel to your backpack, adding a small but thoughtful detail that feels personal without overpowering the bag. What makes it special: • Hand-beaded detailing, so there's depth and subtle variation. • A slight weight that gives it movement without feeling heavy. • A leash clip attachment that stays secure but is easy to reposition. Specs at a glance: 3.25" wide x 4.75" high (including clip) How to style it: This works best when you let it stand alone. It doesn't need competition. Clip it onto a clean silhouette and let the texture do the work. If you're figuring out how to decorate a backpack without adding clutter, this is your move. Personalization, Without the Panic If you've ever wondered how to decorate a backpack and immediately worried about ruining it, you're not alone. Here's how to make it yours without second-guessing: • Use built-in hardware like rings and zipper pulls. • Stick with removable accessories so your style can shift with you. • Choose professional monogramming options for a clean, lasting finish. • Avoid overcrowding one area. Balance always looks more intentional. • Let the design do its part. You don't have to add everything at once. It's Not Just a Backpack. It's Yours! There's no one "right" way to decorate your backpack, and that's exactly why it works. Some days, it's a monogram that makes your backpack feel polished and personal. Other days, it's a charm or two that adds playful movement and a little something extra. Start with a bag that already works for your life and then add details that feel like a natural extension of you, not an afterthought. A few thoughtful touches can turn everyday bags into personalized backpacks that feel more considered, more functional, and more you, without compromising quality or style.
